findings.title: Hit clip truncates to authoritative 250ms window
findings.evidence: shared/sim.js:225 sets hitUntil=tick+5 without changing idle state. Bank selects hit only while hitUntil>tick and advances unscaled elapsed milliseconds. 800ms 8-frame fixture renders frames 0,0,1,1,2 at ticks10..14 then selects idle at15. Retained reproduce-hit.log.
findings.recommendation: Map hit episode elapsed fraction to full clip duration while preserving simulation window; test real idle entity with hitUntil, not permanent state=hit.

findings.title: Finite preview GIFs always repeat
findings.evidence: preview() writes loop=0 unconditionally and main passes only durations, losing metadata.loop=false. Finite hit/attack/recovery clips therefore preview as endless loops. Source verified only.
findings.recommendation: Pass loop policy into preview; omit loop extension for finite clips and verify exported GIF timing/loop metadata.
